description_daylight: The Earth in ink, lit by where the sun is right now. Paper is day and black is night, and the rays run out toward the sun.
description_music_visualiser: 166 lo-fi tracks from a public-domain collection, each visualised as it plays across {{scenes}} scenes.
description_tree_of_life: Every living thing on one globe, drawn from the Open Tree of Life. Start at the origin of life and walk to any species alive today; every organism along the way has a portrait.
